title: Prove the browser-only fresh start: journey, copy, docs
description:
SPIDR child D of task-bb844c288fb346c0856778c738b9f073 - the hardening child. dependsOn child C (task-0a5d7212a7f644d5891df4e0e1545787). Filed by architect-d1711c47 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the proof that the capability children A-C shipped actually works from a browser against a real daemon, plus every sentence in the repo that currently says it does not.

MEASURED AT 68eb1c5d - the exact doc anchors (the parent DoD's wording does not match the tree; use THESE):
- apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts:91-93 - the sentence to delete is split across lines and ends `+ " seed); the browser cannot drive the pre-activation chain.";`. The parent DoD's grep (`grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" <file>` = 0 matches) is satisfiable as written.
- README.md:88-91 - the 'What this is not' sentence reads "a fresh project cannot be started from the browser alone (goal creation waits on the project activation chain, which the seed script or the wrapper drives)". Also re-date the "Measured on 2026-09-03" stamp on line 88.
- docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:47-52 - the paragraph is `**New Goal** remains disabled until the project ledger contains legitimate durable repository, provider, distribution, backup, credential, and store receipts. The current fresh-project browser flow has no production writer for that complete receipt set...`. NOTE: the parent DoD calls this the "New Goal remains disabled" paragraph, but the literal string in the file is bolded markdown - `grep -n "New Goal" docs/agent-stack-runbook.md` finds it at :47. Do not chase the unbolded string; it does not exist.
- The e2e lane is REAL and already drives a daemon: tests/e2e/control-room/ with playwright.config.ts, `pnpm test:e2e:browser` = `tsc -p tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json && playwright test -c ...` (package.json:22). daemon-ports.ts exports `withDaemonBackedControlRoom` and lane options `seed: "NONE"` / `approval: "HUMAN"` - board-chain.spec.ts:1-33 documents the idiom and is the model to copy.
- IMPORTANT: board-chain.spec.ts drives the LEGACY dev board (`cr.liveboard.*` testids, DEV_PAYLOADS). The new journey must drive the V2 surface - the Activate card child C shipped - or it proves the old path, not the product.
- tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json CANNOT reach into apps/ (TS6059), so expected strings are HAND-TRANSCRIBED from the modules that produce them; deriving them from those modules would make the assertions self-referential. Follow board-chain.spec.ts:35-43's stated reasoning.

NOT IN SCOPE: changing production behaviour. If the journey finds a defect, that is a finding to report against child A/B/C - not a fix to smuggle in here.
definitionOfDone: A Playwright journey under tests/e2e/control-room/ drives, against a REAL daemon with `seed: "NONE"` (no fixtures, empty store): browser-only register -> Activate project -> New Goal enabled -> goal.create_with_source ACCEPTED. `pnpm test:e2e:browser` quoted with its count line. The journey drives the V2 Activate card, NOT the legacy `cr.liveboard.*` dev board.

`grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts` returns 0 matches at the delivered tree, and the replacement copy names the Activate card; live-goal-create's own test is updated so the new copy is asserted, not merely absent.

README.md:88-91 'What this is not' fresh-project sentence rewritten to the measured truth (and the 'Measured on' date stamp updated), and docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:47-52 'New Goal remains disabled' paragraph rewritten - both in the SAME commit as the journey.
A live drive on the lane is recorded as a row comment: store path, HEAD sha, transcript and screenshots, per row rail 4. Keep each comment under 4500 chars (fields truncate silently at 5000).
`pnpm seed` still green with its count line quoted, and the wrapper's bootstrap path untouched - `git diff --stat` over the wrapper path shows no change.

Whole-parent regression, gates all quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (root lane), `pnpm test:e2e:browser`. Repo-wide legs are evaluated as a path-attributed baseline (global rail 3): record merge-base failures, HEAD failures, and disclose any foreign red verbatim.

Adversarial pass over the whole parent feature: what happens on a second concurrent Activate click, on a non-git project directory, on a project whose store is read-only, and when the daemon restarts mid-chain. Findings recorded in the completion summary.
taskRails: PROVE IT LIVE: an offline e2e over a REAL daemon is necessary but NOT sufficient - the completion must also record a live drive (transcript, store path, sha) in a row comment. Never restart the wrapper to unstick a seat (claim TTL 30 min).
NO PRODUCTION BEHAVIOUR CHANGES. A defect found by the journey is reported against child A/B/C, not patched here - a hardening row that edits the thing it certifies proves nothing.
The journey drives the V2 Activate card. A journey that clicks the legacy `cr.liveboard.*` dev board re-proves the pre-existing fake-witness path and does NOT satisfy this row.

implementationPlan.description: GATE AND RE-MEASURE. This row proves what children A-C2 shipped, so start only when all four are DONE: A task-741dad13e23d441a8385d0f14df5b5c1, B task-4b9c394debe94b41a80e2b46c6d55ab8, C task-0a5d7212a7f644d5891df4e0e1545787 (daemon read route), C2 task-3506e04abcef4fc3a69299ca238ae1b3 (the Activate card). NOTE: this row's `dependsOn` field names only C — C2 was split out of C at plan time and I could not add it (`moe.set_task_dependencies` refuses this seat: `[NOT_ALLOWED] architect or governor role required`). C2 is the row that ships the card this journey clicks, so verify it yourself via get_context.epicSiblings or `git log main --grep 'Moe-Task: task-3506e04a'`; if it is not DONE, report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds naming it. Then re-measure the three doc anchors, because this row's DoD quotes two of them wrongly and the plan corrects both: `grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts` (expect 1 match at :93), `grep -n "New Goal" docs/agent-stack-runbook.md` (expect :47, BOLDED as `**New Goal** remains disabled` — the unbolded string the DoD quotes returns 0 matches repo-wide), and README.md:88-91 including its 'Measured on 2026-09-03' stamp.

STUDY THE LANE, then decide the journey's shape. Read `tests/e2e/control-room/board-chain.spec.ts:1-45` for the idiom and its two stated reasons: (a) `seed: "NONE"` leaves the store EMPTY so every commit is authored by a click on a production control — the only arrangement that can see a board-driven move break; (b) this directory's tsconfig CANNOT reach into apps/ (TS6059), so expected strings are HAND-TRANSCRIBED from the modules that produce them, because deriving them would make the assertions self-referential. Follow both. THE CRITICAL DIFFERENCE FROM board-chain.spec.ts: it navigates to `${lane.baseUrl}?v1=1` (:424), and that `?v1=1` param is what serves the LEGACY dev board with its fake DEV_PAYLOADS witness. This journey must navigate to `lane.baseUrl` with NO `v1` param so the V2 app is served — a journey that clicks `cr.liveboard.*` re-proves the pre-existing fake-witness path and certifies nothing. Read `pairing-operator-channel.spec.ts` for how a v2 lane reaches a paired session, and `daemon-ports.ts:376-390` for `DaemonLaneOptions` (`approval`, `liveCredentials`, `seed`, the operator channel).

THE JOURNEY. Create the spec under `tests/e2e/control-room/`. One lane: `withDaemonBackedControlRoom({ approval: "HUMAN", liveCredentials: "ATTACHED", seed: "NONE", ... })`, asserting `lane.seedPid` is null so the lane proves it ran unseeded. Then, in the browser and ONLY in the browser: navigate to `lane.baseUrl` (no `?v1=1`), reach a paired session, land on the Goals screen, assert New Goal is BLOCKED with the daemon's stated reason, find `cr.activate.root`, assert the receipt rows render, click `cr.activate.button` once, wait for the four chain steps to record, then assert New Goal is now ENABLED and drive `goal.create_with_source` to an ACCEPTED answer. Assert the receipts are MEASURED, not merely present: the repository row must carry the lane's actual HEAD sha (the lane knows it; transcribe rather than derive), and no row may read as a `<projectId>-*` literal. Seat a DOM recorder before the first click — board-chain.spec.ts:26-33 documents why: a card's dispatch report lives only until the next surface poll re-keys the card, so a watcher sampling on its own schedule can watch a dispatch succeed and see nothing.

REPLACE THE COPY THAT CONTRADICTS THE PRODUCT. In `apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts:88-93`, the BLOCKED branch of `goalCreateRefusal` currently ends `" seed); the browser cannot drive the pre-activation chain."`. Replace the whole next-step sentence so it names the Activate card as the action the operator can take here, keeping the function's existing discipline: the prerequisite phrasing still comes from `labelForMissing`, never a paraphrase, and no sentence may carry a credential, csrf token or header. Update `live-goal-create.test.ts` to ASSERT THE NEW SENTENCE, not merely the absence of the old one — an absence-only assertion passes if someone deletes the branch entirely. `grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts` must return 0 matches at the delivered tree (DoD 2).

REWRITE THE DOCS TO THE MEASURED TRUTH, in the SAME commit as the journey. README.md:88-91 — the 'What this is not' list currently opens 'a fresh project cannot be started from the browser alone (goal creation waits on the project activation chain, which the seed script or the wrapper drives)'. Rewrite that clause to what now ships, and re-date the 'Measured on 2026-09-03' stamp on line 88. Leave every OTHER claim in that paragraph alone — the one-node fence, the missing preview/release gates, the Codex seat and the trusted-workspace verifier are all still true and are other rows' work. docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:47-52 — the paragraph says '**New Goal** remains disabled until the project ledger contains legitimate durable repository, provider, distribution, backup, credential, and store receipts. The current fresh-project browser flow has no production writer for that complete receipt set, so the project activation and goal cards remain blocked...'. The first sentence stays TRUE and should stay; it is the 'no production writer' sentence that is now false. Say what the Activate card does and that the daemon mints the witness from measured facts. Keep the surrounding manager-flow prose intact.

GATES, LIVE DRIVE, ADVERSARIAL PASS. Run and QUOTE COUNT LINES for all of: `pnpm test:e2e:browser` (the new journey), `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (demo-seed-*.test.ts must be green — parent DoD 4), `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (root lane — label it 'root lane only, apps/** not covered'). Grade every leg on its `Test Files N passed` line, never its exit code (global rail 8). Repo-wide legs are a path-attributed baseline (global rail 3): record merge-base failures, HEAD failures, and the delta intersected with this feature's owned paths; disclose any foreign red verbatim with its exact failing lines and never fabricate green. Confirm the wrapper's bootstrap path is untouched (`git diff --stat` vs merge-base over the wrapper paths). THEN THE LIVE DRIVE (row rail 4): drive a real fresh project in a real browser and record in a row comment the store path, the HEAD sha, the transcript and the screenshots — keep each comment under 4500 chars, fields truncate silently at 5000. ADVERSARIAL PASS over the whole parent feature: a second concurrent Activate click; a project directory that is not a git repo; a read-only store; a daemon restart mid-chain; a backups directory that already exists. Findings go in the completion summary. FINDINGS ARE REPORTED, NOT PATCHED: a defect in A/B/C/C2 is a comment on that row, because a hardening row that edits what it certifies proves nothing.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 7 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected extending board-chain.spec.ts: it navigates to `${lane.baseUrl}?v1=1`, and that param serves the LEGACY dev board whose DEV_PAYLOADS witness is exactly the fake this feature removes. Extending it would prove the old path. A new spec on the V2 surface is the only journey that certifies the product.

Rejected deriving the expected strings from apps/ modules: tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json cannot reach apps/ (TS6059), and board-chain.spec.ts:35-43 states the deeper reason — assertions derived from the module that produces them pass whatever the board put on screen. Hand-transcribe, as that spec does.

Rejected asserting only that the receipts render: the whole point is that they are MEASURED, so the journey asserts the repository row carries the lane's actual HEAD sha and that no row reads as a `<projectId>-*` literal. Rendering six rows would pass just as well against the old fake witness.

On the docs, rejected rewriting the whole README paragraph: only the fresh-project clause is now false. The one-node fence, the absent preview/release gates, the Codex seat and the trusted-workspace verifier are still true and belong to other rows of this epic — rewriting them here would make the README claim capability that has not shipped.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
MEASURED AT main 68eb1c5d.

THE DoD MIS-QUOTES TWO ANCHORS; the plan corrects both.
- `grep -rn "New Goal remains disabled" --include=*.md .` -> 0 MATCHES. The real line is docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:47 and it is BOLDED: `**New Goal** remains disabled until the project ledger contains legitimate durable repository, provider, distribution, backup, credential, and store receipts.` The FALSE sentence is the next one: 'The current fresh-project browser flow has no production writer for that complete receipt set, so the project activation and goal cards remain blocked with their exact missing-authority reasons.'
- README.md:88-91: 'Measured on 2026-09-03, these are still missing or manual: a fresh project cannot be started from the browser alone (goal creation waits on the project activation chain, which the seed script or the wrapper drives); ...'. The date stamp on :88 also needs re-dating.
- live-goal-create.ts:88-93 IS accurate as the DoD states it: the BLOCKED branch of `goalCreateRefusal` ends `+ " seed); the browser cannot drive the pre-activation chain.";` at :93, and the DoD's grep is satisfiable verbatim.

THE LANE IS REAL AND ALREADY DRIVES A DAEMON.
- package.json:22 `test:e2e:browser` = `tsc -p tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json && playwright test -c tests/e2e/control-room/playwright.config.ts`.
- daemon-ports.ts:376+ `DaemonLaneOptions` = `approval?` (omitted = SPEED), `fixedDemoGoal?`, `liveCredentials`, `seed`, plus an operator-channel option; `withDaemonBackedControlRoom(options, fn)` yields a `DaemonLane` with `baseUrl` and `seedPid` (NULL when `seed: "NONE"`).
- daemon-ports.ts:14-18 states why an unseeded lane is the only one that can see a board-driven move break.

THE `?v1=1` PARAM IS THE WHOLE GAME. board-chain.spec.ts:424 does `page.goto(`${lane.baseUrl}?v1=1`)` and then asserts `cr.liveboard` — that is the LEGACY board with DEV_PAYLOADS. Navigating without the param serves V2. A journey that forgets this passes while proving the wrong surface.

DOM RECORDER, not sampling: board-chain.spec.ts:26-33 — live-board keys reports by [kind, aggregateId, version], so the commit that answers a click is also what destroys the answer's rendering. Seat a recorder before the first click.

EXISTING V2-REACHING SPECS to copy pairing from: journeys.spec.ts, prd-to-approval.spec.ts, prd-persistence-boundary.spec.ts, pairing-operator-channel.spec.ts.
planningNotes.risks:
1. THE `?v1=1` TRAP. Copying board-chain.spec.ts's navigation verbatim serves the legacy board, and the journey will pass while proving the fake-witness path this whole feature removes. This is the single most likely way to ship a green row that certifies nothing.

2. THIS ROW'S dependsOn IS INCOMPLETE. It names C (task-0a5d7212) but not C2 (task-3506e04a), which was split out of C at plan time and is the row that actually ships the card this journey clicks. `moe.set_task_dependencies` refuses this architect seat, so step 1 verifies C2 by hand. A worker who trusts the field alone can start against a board with no Activate card.

3. FAIL-CLOSED NEEDS A REAL PROVIDER CLI. Child B refuses activation when any receipt is unmeasurable, and the provider receipt probes `claude --version`. If the e2e host has no provider CLI on PATH, the journey fails at the Activate step for an environmental reason that looks exactly like a code defect. Check the host before debugging the card.

4. THE DOCS PARAGRAPHS CARRY OTHER ROWS' TRUTHS. README:88-101 and runbook:45-52 each mix this feature's claim with claims about the one-node fence, preview/release gates, the Codex seat, the verifier and the manager flow. Rewriting more than the fresh-project clause would make the repo claim capability that has not shipped — a worse defect than the stale sentence.

5. AN ABSENCE-ONLY COPY TEST IS VACUOUS. Asserting the old sentence is gone passes if someone deletes the whole BLOCKED branch. Assert the NEW sentence.

6. THE LIVE DRIVE IS NOT OPTIONAL and is not satisfied by the e2e run (row rail 4). Never restart the wrapper to unstick a seat — the claim TTL is 30 minutes.
